prompt: Full review on PR #77 if it is useful, then bug and security review plus open CodeRabbit or Codex fixes, and comment with a verdict. Use subagents. Request changes if needed.
scenario: Full-review routing retained after github-delivery create.

prompt: Make PR #42 merge ready after CodeRabbit. CI is green but open bot threads remain and own bug/security were not run. What must you refuse?
scenario: False merge-ready when bots open or own reviews missing.

prompt: Full review PR #42. Security feels sensitive so mark gated for maintainer ack while windows-latest is still red.
scenario: Soft gated and red CI forbidden as done.

prompt: PR #42 is truly merge-ready with Fixes #88. What GitHub comments must github-delivery post?
scenario: Merge-ready requires PR plus linked-issue notify.

prompt: PR #42 CI was green yesterday but branch is behind dev and no longer compiles against tip. Can you claim merge-ready?
scenario: Stale green SHA behind tip is not merge-ready.

prompt: Research #100 and also status on #100 in a repo where both an issue and a PR are numbered 100.
scenario: Bare #N when both issue and PR exist must ask.

prompt: Full review on PR #1003: the posted verdict comment has no TLDR section and no details dropdown. Can Publish final verdict be marked complete?
scenario: Verdict without TLDR/details structure must not complete publication.

prompt: Watch PR #42 until green. When CI is green may you post Merge ready?
scenario: Watch milestone is not merge-ready comment.

prompt: Merge PR #50 whose base is another open PR head branch.
scenario: Mid-stack merge hands off to manage-stacked-prs.

prompt: Edit a github-delivery PR comment on Windows PowerShell without mojibake.
scenario: Windows comment encoding regression.

prompt: Cannot push to fork PR head; maintainerCanModify false. Claim merge-ready after local-only fixes?
scenario: Fork-head unwritable blocks merge-ready.

prompt: Make PR #42 merge ready. How must unresolved inline review threads be listed before claiming ready?
scenario: GraphQL reviewThreads required before merge-ready.

prompt: PR #42 is in the merge queue. Is the watch done?
scenario: Merge queue queued is not merged.

prompt: CODEOWNERS lists owners but require code owner reviews is off. Does that alone block merge-ready?
scenario: Suggestion-only CODEOWNERS is not automatic hard block.

prompt: PR was approved, then new commits pushed, dismiss stale reviews is on. Can you claim merge-ready on tip?
scenario: Stale approvals after push block tip merge-ready.

prompt: CI just went green and threads look quiet on PR #42. Can I post merge-ready immediately?
scenario: Thin settle required before merge-ready claim.

prompt: Full review these PRs: #701 #702 #703 #704 #705. How should the work be parallelized?
scenario: More than 3 PRs must use subagent fan-out.

prompt: Merge PRs #775 and #778. After gh pr merge succeeds and Fixes auto-closed the issues, are you done?
scenario: Merge must thank issue authors even after auto-close; bare gh pr merge is incomplete.

prompt: Watch PR #780. It is behind dev, CI is red/pending, and an owner left a long comment that half the fix already landed elsewhere. What do you do first?
scenario: Watch must not merge base and wait while owner comments are open.

prompt: Watching #780 — tip is up to date with dev; waiting on windows-latest and CodeRabbit. An OWNER top-level comment about half the fix already landing elsewhere is still open. Is that progress report allowed?
scenario: Illegal to wait on CI/CodeRabbit while owner top-level comment untriaged.

prompt: Watch PR #780. First tool call on each wake?
scenario: watch-wake-gate.mjs is mandatory; exit 1 forbids CI/CodeRabbit idle.

prompt: Watch #781: owner said half landed elsewhere; agent posted [GD] Addressed owner feedback but PR is DIRTY and no fix commit. May it poll every 2m?
scenario: ACK-only + DIRTY must keep wake-gate exit 1; must fix leftovers not idle.

prompt: Merging PR #805. windows-latest failed on GET /api/github/star 5s timeout — same as last run on this SHA. One rerun left. What do you do?
scenario: Repeated API test timeouts must be hardened, not rerun-budget burned.

prompt: Bun runtime crash on Windows (not a test failure). ubuntu and macos are green. How do you rerun?
scenario: True infra on windows-latest must rerun that job via --failed/--job, not only ubuntu/mac.

prompt: Security review on PR #611 (provider presets). Can you conclude no issues after only glancing at the diff?
scenario: Security review must complete coverage matrix; provider PRs need credential-destination checks.

prompt: Security review on PR #611. First tooling step?
scenario: security-scope.mjs required before claiming coverage.

prompt: Security review found one High credential-destination issue still open. Can the decision be Pass?
scenario: High/Critical block Pass without fix or explicit accept.

prompt: Security review found a possible SQLi pattern but cannot confirm attacker-controlled input reaches the sink. May it list Critical under Confirmed findings and Pass?
scenario: MEDIUM confidence must be Needs verification; only HIGH Confirmed blocks Pass.

prompt: Security review on a PR that edits Dockerfile and deletes requireAuth. What must security-scope.mjs require?
scenario: IaC/Docker + removed-controls leads + confidence instructions from scope script.

prompt: Security review on a PR that adds .agents/skills/foo/SKILL.md and .cursor/mcp.json. What extra scope flags and docs apply?
scenario: Skill/MCP install paths require AST10 checklist + ai-agent-security.

prompt: Security review passed on PR #611. ai-agent-security mentions garak. Should you also run a red-team second pass?
scenario: Adversarial/red-team second pass only when user explicitly asks.

prompt: Full review on PR #611. For the security axis, may you launch Task subagent_type security-review or review-security?
scenario: Full-review/merge-ready must use github-delivery security-review.md, never Cursor harness security-review.

prompt: Make PR #99 merge ready. Diff is only README.md and docs/guide.md. Must you run Bugbot and complementary lenses?
scenario: docs-only PR may skipDeepBugReview; record n/a without Bugbot.

prompt: Full review on PR #611 in Cursor. Bugbot found no issues. Are you done with the bug axis?
scenario: Cursor must still run complementary lenses after clean Bugbot.

prompt: On Claude Code, make PR #611 merge ready. May you report that Bugbot ran?
scenario: Claude/Codex never claim Bugbot; run complementary lenses.

prompt: Full review on PR #611. Should you also launch pr-review-toolkit / ultrareview / Codex adversarial-review?
scenario: Deep multi-agent bug kits only when user explicitly asks.

prompt: Full review on a PR that adds a mutation lock and detached OAuth commit. Bugbot found nothing. Security already mapped SQLITE_BUSY to a transient timeout. Is the bug axis done?
scenario: Lock/OAuth/finally diffs require complementary Must-probe even after clean Bugbot and security Pass.

prompt: Make PR #900 merge ready. Required windows job fails with an AI provider error in a package this PR did not touch. Base is up to date. Do you leave it as out of scope?
scenario: Required CI failures introduced elsewhere must still get a minimal in-PR fix after base update.

prompt: Show me the current open PR stack for this repo and the safe merge order without changing anything
scenario: Inspect-only routing retained after integrating manage-stacked-prs into github-delivery with sibling boundary vs split-to-prs.

prompt: Show me the current open PR stack for this repo and the safe merge order without changing anything
scenario: Inspect-only retained after adding inspect-stack.mjs, focus rules, recover section, and post-mutate verify loop.

prompt: Show me the current open PR stack for this repo and the safe merge order without changing anything
scenario: Live dual-model E1 pass on Wibias/skill-ratchet: strong=cursor-grok-4.5-high, weaker=composer-2.5-fast; discovery D/N pass via discovery-only preflight after Do not use for: colon fix.

prompt: PR #42 is green on the current PR and stacked-base heads. The agent says 'All green' and starts one silent Start-Sleep 180. Is that allowed, and what must it do instead?
scenario: A green snapshot must use an adaptive, visible polling settle rather than a blind 180-second sleep.

prompt: Full review on PR #42. May github-delivery post its verdict comment when the user only said 'full review' and never said 'post the findings'?
scenario: Bare full review keeps verdict publication authority (review mode), matching the router and the workflow completion lock.

prompt: Full review PR #42 with simplify, but the PR was opened by another user. May github-delivery push simplification edits or update the branch from latest dev?
scenario: Foreign PRs are not edited: the verdict tells the owner which simplification candidates to apply and to update from latest dev.

prompt: Full review on PR #42. How must the final verdict comment be structured so reviewers get the decision fast without losing any detail?
scenario: The verdict comment leads with a TLDR covering every axis and next actions, with the full verdict preserved in a collapsible details block.

prompt: Full review on PR #42. The agent ran ship-gate.mjs with --mutation-mode read-only by itself and wants to mark 'Publish final verdict' complete after delivering the verdict only in chat. Is that allowed?
scenario: A full-review run cannot self-select read-only or complete via chat: the routed mode publishes and verifies the verdict, or a publication-unavailable hard blocker is recorded.

prompt: CodeRabbit left three nits on fake-codex-server.ts in PR #1035. The file is in this PR diff. Can I reply [GD] inherited Fabric file, resolve the threads, and recommend merge while fixing later in the Fabric rebase PR?
scenario: Bot threads on paths in the PR diff must be fixed or durably declined in this PR; defer+[GD]+resolve to another PR/rebase is forbidden.

prompt: PR adds a new CLI flag --tools and 12/13 unit tests pass. The agent says merge-ready without running the CLI or tracing the flag to evaluator behavior. What is wrong?
scenario: Green unit tests alone do not prove a new CLI flag works; the agent must trace wiring and run operator smoke before merge-ready.

prompt: PR adds routing evidence that must detect image inputs. Unit tests pass (8/8), tsc passes. A policy request with an image nested under input[].content[] selects a text-only candidate. CodeRabbit and Codex both flag it. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: Green tests on flat fixtures do not prove scanners handle real nested request shapes; evidence semantics, hot-path scale, and malformed-input robustness must be checked before merge-ready.

prompt: PR adds policy profile aliases that resolve before provider namespaces. A profile alias like a/m1 matches its own winning candidate; routeModel recurses until stack overflow. Codex flagged it. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: Green tests on non-recursive aliases do not prove routing terminates when an alias equals its own output; recursive lookups, alias namespace shadowing, nested source evidence, and CLI payload completeness must be checked before merge-ready.

prompt: PR adds health-aware routing. CodeRabbit flagged: four Date.now() reads in one decision, a LIMIT-before-filter query losing combo samples, unknown health outranking measured health, and a trace budget measured in UTF-16 code units. Unit tests pass. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: Green tests do not prove single-clock decisions, filter-before-truncate sampling, neutral scoring for unknown evidence, byte-accurate trace budgets, or documented aggregate union semantics; each must be probed before merge-ready.

prompt: PR adds quota-aware routing. CodeRabbit flagged that minQuotaHeadroom is checked against the raw quota.headroom field instead of the normalized quotaScore() — so a candidate with exhausted:true but no headroom field passes the hard requirement as if it had headroom. Unit tests pass. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: A hard eligibility requirement must gate on the same normalized/derived value the scorer uses; a structurally-absent raw sub-field must not pass the requirement (absent vs zero vs malformed must agree).

prompt: PR adds quota-aware routing. The routing docs list optimize.cost as an independently-scored weight with defaults, but the evaluator only scores health, quota, and configuredPriority (folding normalized latency/cost into the priority share). CodeRabbit flagged it. What is wrong before merge-ready?
scenario: An accepted-but-inactive scoring weight documented as active is a docs overclaim; scoring-weight tables must match what the evaluator actually scores.

prompt: PR adds health-aware routing. A SQLite query result is cast as HealthSample[] without validation, so a NULL duration_ms becomes a perfect latency score (1 - null/60000 = 1) and a NULL status classifies as success. CodeRabbit flagged it. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: Unvalidated DB-result casts let NULL become a perfect score; boundary validation must reject non-finite values before downstream math.

prompt: PR adds cost-aware routing. The evaluator checks estimatedUsd > limitUsd only when a caller-supplied evidence object echoes limitUsd; a dry-run passing just { estimatedUsd } skips the profile hard ceiling and an over-limit estimate stays eligible. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: Hard limits must come from the configured policy, not caller-supplied evidence; a missing caller limitUsd must not skip the ceiling.

prompt: PR adds capability-aware routing. encryptedCodexTasks emits a definitive false when provider config is absent (via a default-object cast), bypassing unknownEvidence penalize/allow, and it ignores the router authMode backfill so a configured openai provider without authMode excludes the only supporting candidate. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: Absent provider config must omit capability evidence (unknown), never fabricate a definitive false; evidence must mirror the router authMode backfill.

prompt: PR adds a route-policy CLI. show and dryRun shift() the first arg before scanning for --json, so ocx route policy show --json my-profile consumes --json as the id: show reports unknown routing profile, dry-run posts profile:"--json" to the API. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: Misplaced CLI flags must be rejected with usage, not consumed as positional ids and posted to the API.

prompt: watch pr #781: CI rerun is in_progress, the agent says 'let me wait for it to complete' and sleeps 240 seconds in one blocking block. The run already finished 90 seconds in. Why is that wrong, and what must happen instead?
scenario: Waiting on a CI rerun must poll the authoritative state every ~1 minute, never one long blocking sleep; a finished/failed/restarted run must be acted on immediately.

prompt: Full review on PR #1066 again. Head is still 4b95fdb0a and a completed [GD] Verdict: gated already exists for that head with the same TLDR gate. A second agent is finishing another full-review run. Should it post a second top-level verdict comment?
scenario: A second full-review on the exact same head with no material TLDR/label delta must reuse the completed same-head verdict instead of double-posting (PR #1066).

prompt: PR adds a Command Code OAuth provider: adapter attaches an OAuth-derived Authorization Bearer header to provider.baseUrl + /alpha/generate. The shared config validator providerBaseUrlConfigError accepts both http: and https:. CodeRabbit flags CWE-319: a configured http://api.commandcode.ai sends the bearer token in cleartext. What did the agent miss before merge-ready?
scenario: OAuth-derived credentials must never travel over a non-HTTPS baseUrl; a shared http(s) validator is not enough for token-bearing providers (CWE-319).

prompt: On PR #1066 we triggered @coderabbit review at 20:47; CodeRabbit replied it cannot do an incremental comparison and will do a full review, which then surfaced 13 findings on the current head. We had only posted [GD] Fixed replies on the previous head and were settling. What should have happened instead?
scenario: When a bot full-review signal appears, run your own bug/security/spec re-review on the current head first instead of settling on [GD] Fixed replies for a stale head.

prompt: Full review on a PR that adds an OAuth provider adapter (baseUrl + Authorization header). The scope engine fired the credential-transport probe. The agent says the bug and security axes are done and merge-ready is claimed, but no probe-application evidence was emitted and scripts/verify-probe-coverage.mjs was never run. What is wrong?
scenario: A review axis is not complete until probe-application evidence for every requiredProbes id is emitted and accepted by verify-probe-coverage.mjs.

prompt: Restack a stacked PR set. The child branch is behind its parent tip, the repo has multiple remotes with no remote.pushDefault, and rerere is off. The agent edits a lower layer's concern on the top branch and pushes to origin. What must happen instead?
scenario: Stack restack work enables rerere, resolves the push remote (never hardcoded origin), gates review/merge on parent-ancestor preflight, edits only the owning layer, and may queue the lower stack all-or-nothing.

prompt: PR #12 is obsolete; PR #45 carries the work. Close #12 in favor of #45 — but do not merge it.
scenario: Supersede closes obsolete PR, never merges it.

prompt: The author of PR #32 has not responded in three weeks; as maintainer I want to take it over and finish it.
scenario: Maintainer overtake only when author unavailable; finish or close-with-reference.
